para.dtcname: Smart entry system inside warning does not sound

content5.ptxt: The various interior warnings of the Smart Entry & Start System (smart entry) use the buzzer in the combination meter assembly (meter ECU). The smart key computer assembly (certification ECU) sends sound signals for the various warning buzzers to the combination meter assembly (meter ECU) via multiplex communication to sound the buzzer.

item.ptxt: The Smart Entry & Start System (smart entry) has functions that use multiplex communication. First, follow "How to Proceed with Troubleshooting" and confirm that there is no malfunction in the communication system before proceeding with troubleshooting.
When using TaSCAN with the ignition switch OFF, repeatedly turn any door courtesy light switch ON←→OFF until communication between TaSCAN and the vehicle starts. (ON←→OFF interval within 1.5 seconds)
When the electrical key transmitter or smart key computer assembly (certification ECU) has been replaced, refer to the registration procedure in the immobiliser reference section.
Check that there are no other electrical key transmitters in the vehicle interior.

testgrp.testtitle: Combination Meter Assembly Function Inspection (Check Buzzer Operation)

test1.ptxt: With the IG ON, check the operation of the buzzer in the combination meter assembly when the shift lever is moved to the reverse position.

testgrp.testtitle: Replace Smart Key Computer Assembly (Certification ECU)
